About this job
Job Offer: Embedded Firmware Developer
Join our growing team in Duisburg as an Embedded Firmware Developer. In this role, you will develop high-quality firmware and low-level software for ASIC and SoC platforms, enabling reliable system functionality and supporting verification and application development.
Job Description:
Contribute to low level C/C++ development within customer projects
Communicate with internal and external development partners
Collaborate in the development, extension, and documentation of low-level software and driver concepts
Align concepts with cross-line and customer requirements (verification, validation, application development)
Support requirements engineering for low level software with internal project teams and customers
Ensure useability of low level software for verification, validation and application development
Support ASIC validation
Requirements:
University degree (Dipl.-Ing., M.Sc., or PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
At least 5+ years of experience in the field of low level software development
Hands-on experience in firmware and embedded software development, particularly strong with C programming
Understanding of semiconductors fundamentals and mixed-signal integrated electronics
Knowledge of RTOS, including bring-up and porting to SoCs for 3rd party application development
Professional English and German language communication skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving and teamwork skills
Good to have skills:
Basic experience in project management
Hands-on experience with System Verilog or VHDL
Basic knowledge of the UVM methodology
About us:
Racyics® is Europe’s leading design service provider for mixed-signal system-on-chip design and turnkey ASIC services in advanced nodes.
We deliver professional analog, digital and mixed-signal design services tailored to the customers’ needs with focus on realization of complex System-on-Chips in leading edge technology nodes. Our team of more than 150 employees covers the complete chip design process up to system architecture development. Racyics is working for major German and international semi-custom companies both as a service provider and in collaborative partnerships.
Working at Racyics comes with many benefits, including flexible working hours, mobile work, a financial contribution to your childcare costs and great team events.
